description: Defines the expected fields and valid values for professions in Castronegro.

building.description: Associated building of the profession. Can be null for roles without a fixed location.

power.description: Defines how the profession’s power behaves.

effect.description: Narrative or mechanical description of the profession’s ability.

assignable.description: Indicates whether this profession can be directly assigned to a player.

active.description: Marks whether this profession is currently in use or available in the game.
